title: NGFR-mNG2 Sorting Protocol
author: Benjamin Emert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rh6d39e

steps.title: Dissociate Cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate 1xDPBS and incubate cells with 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA at 37ºC.

steps.title: Neutralize Trypsin and Collect Cells
steps.instruction: Neutralize the trypsin and transfer the dissociated cells to 15mL falcon tubes.

substeps.instruction: Add 4mL TU2% media to neutralize trypsin
Transfer cells to 15mL falcon tubes (one tube can hold cells from 2.5 10cm plates)

steps.title: First Centrifugation and Buffer Preparation
steps.instruction: Pellet the cells and prepare the resuspension buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,000 rpm (200rcf) or 300 rcf for 3 minutes
Prepare excess sterile 1xDPBS with 2mM EDTA during centrifugation

steps.title: Initial Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 5mL 1xDPBS with 2mM EDTA (pellets may be combined at this stage).

steps.title: Second Centrifugation and Reagent Preparation
steps.instruction: Pellet the cells again while preparing staining solutions and collection tubes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare live dead staining solution using one of the following: 4uL/mL 7-AAD (final 200ng/mL), 2uL/mL Propidium iodide (final 100ng/mL), or 1uL/mL DAPI (final 50ng/mL)
Prepare sterile 5mL polypropylene FACS tubes containing 1mL TU2% for collecting sorted cells

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Staining
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellets in 1xDPBS with 2mM EDTA and the chosen dead cell stain.

substeps.instruction: Use typically 6mL of solution for 5 10cm plates' worth of cells

steps.title: Filter and Chill Cells
steps.instruction: Remove cell clumps and prepare for sorting.

substeps.instruction: Pass cell suspension through a cell strainer cap into sterile 5mL polypropylene FACS tubes

steps.title: Prepare Materials for Sorting
steps.instruction: Gather the following items for the sorting session:

substeps.instruction: 1xDPBS with 2mM EDTA and dead cell stain (for diluting cells)
5mL polypropylene FACS tubes with 1mL TU2% (for collecting cells)
